title: Dhaval Packaging's Rs. 36.36 crore IPO to open on July 30

The IPO aims to list on the BSE SME platform on August 6.

title: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions posts Rs 55-cr profit in Q1

A record 500 MW capacity was added in the first quarter.

title: Bitcoin slips below $63,000 to a two-week low as weak Coinbase earnings and fading optimism weigh on sentiment
